def get_schema_from_model_field(
    *,\
    field: ModelField,\
    model_name_map: ModelNameMap,\
    field_mapping: Dict[\
        Tuple[ModelField, Literal["validation", "serialization"]], JsonSchemaValue\
    ],\
    separate_input_output_schemas: bool = True,\
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    # Determine the mode to use for schema retrieval.
    # If separate_input_output_schemas is True, we use field.mode.
    # If False, we prefer field.mode if it's not 'validation', otherwise we use 'validation'.
    if separate_input_output_schemas:
        mode = field.mode
    else:
        # When separate_input_output_schemas is False, we want the schema that
        # contains all necessary information, which is usually field.mode.
        # We only fall back to 'validation' if field.mode is not available or is 'validation'.
        mode = field.mode if field.mode != "validation" else "validation"

    # This expects that GenerateJsonSchema was already used to generate the definitions
    json_schema = field_mapping[(field, mode)]
    if "$ref" not in json_schema:
        # TODO remove when deprecating Pydantic v1
        # Ref: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/blob/d61792cc42c80b13b23e3ffa74bc37ec7c77f7d1/pydantic/schema.py#L207
        json_schema["title"] = field.field_info.title or field.alias.title().replace(
            "_", " "
        )
    return json_schema
